summary:
All my new specs pass (13 passing); the 5 failures are pre-existing scaffold specs (AppComponent title, and three `No provider for HttpClient` specs) that fail on the original checkout too — untouched as out of scope.

**Reading taken:** item 1 (Tutorial entity, `/api/tutorials` endpoints, EF migration, CORS) is backend work and belongs to the separate `realworld-dotnet` repository, which I cannot edit from here — I implemented only the frontend side.

What I changed here:
- `src/environments/environment.ts` (new) — `apiUrl: 'http://localhost:5001/api'`.
- `src/app/interceptors/api.interceptor.ts` (new) — prefixes relative request URLs with `environment.apiUrl`, leaves absolute URLs alone; registered via `HTTP_INTERCEPTORS` in `app.module.ts`.
- `src/app/services/tutorial.service.ts` — base URL is now the relative `/tutorials`, resolved by the interceptor.
- `src/app/models/tutorial.model.ts` — added `createdAt` / `updatedAt`.
- `src/app/components/tutorial-drawer/` (new component) — right-hand side drawer with backdrop, showing title, description, published status and created/updated dates, Publish/UnPublish and Delete buttons, and an Edit link to `/tutorials/:id`; renders "Not found" on a 404 from the API.
- `tutorials-list.component.{ts,html}` — clicking a list item now opens the drawer (by id, so the drawer re-fetches and can surface 404s); the drawer refreshes the list on change and clears selection on close. This replaced the inline read-only details panel in the list column.
- Tests: new `tutorial-drawer.component.spec.ts` and `api.interceptor.spec.ts`, plus drawer open/close coverage added to `tutorials-list.component.spec.ts`.

Note: the drawer reads `createdAt`/`updatedAt` as camelCase JSON; if the backend serializes those fields under different names, that mapping will need aligning once the endpoint exists.
blockers: Not applied -- Tutorials API: Tutorial entity, GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/tutorials, GET /api/tutorials/:id, GET /api/tutorials?title=, 404 handling, EF migration, CORS for http://localhost:4200: Backend work belonging to the counterpart repository realworld-dotnet, which is read-only reference here and outside this repo's allowed file paths

Visual verification failed: The /tutorials route renders only the search bar, 'Tutorials List' heading and Remove All button — the list is empty because the backend at http://localhost:5001/api is not running, so no tutorial can be clicked and the new side drawer (title/description/status/dates, Publish/Delete/Edit) is never visible. I could not script a click with a mocked API (command permissions denied), so the drawer feature could not be visually confirmed.

endpoints.purpose: Search tutorials by title via query string
Fetch one tutorial for the details drawer; 404 renders 'Not found'
Update a tutorial / toggle published state

context_sharing.notes: Services use the relative path '/tutorials'; ApiInterceptor prefixes every non-absolute URL with environment.apiUrl ('http://localhost:5001/api'), so the effective base is http://localhost:5001/api. All Tutorial fields are optional; id is declared `any`, and createdAt/updatedAt are typed string and rendered raw. PUT responses are read for an optional `message` string; GET /tutorials/{id} must return 404 (not an empty body) for missing ids.
